name: Hall of Fame Tennis Camp
description_short: A half-day junior tennis camp for ages 8-16 at the International Tennis Hall of Fame in Newport. It runs Monday to Friday, 8:30-11:30 am, in weekly sessions with at most 4 players per court.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The season is unclear. The page says 'Weekly sessions beginning June 15' with no year. June 15, 2026 was a Monday, and the camp runs Monday to Friday, so this probably describes the 2026 season, which has already happened. June 15, 2027 is a Tuesday. The page also says grass courts reopen in May 2027. 2027 prices and dates may be different.
No individual weeks are listed, only the start date, so no sessions were recorded.
Prices depend on membership: $450/week for members, $600/week for non-members. A $200 Junior Summer Membership gives discounted camp rates. price_per_week uses the non-member rate.
The page also lists a separate Hall of Fame Beginner Program for ages 4-7 (Tue/Thu, 3:30-4:30 pm, $80 member / $120 non-member per week). That is a weekly class, not this camp, so it was left out.
The phone number is the Pro Shop, which the page gives for court bookings and lessons. The general ITHF number in the footer is 401-849-3990. The email is the general Hall of Fame address.
